name: Rex
physical_description: Half lobster, half man - a stout anthropomorphic lobster with a bright red segmented carapace, broad-chested and muscular, with large working claws. Large white bulging eyes and a thick curled red mustache.
main_outfit_description: An open olive-green leather vest over a bare chest, with a brown bandolier strap across the torso and a wide brown belt. White/grey textured pants. Topped off with a small brown pirate captain's hat featuring a white skull-and-crossbones emblem.

music.name: Merchants and Sea Salt
music.description: a steady, easy-going harbour-town tune; for working through a plan, logistics, or a calm watch at sea
music.credit: "Merchants and Sea Salt" by NBJDLukasAbsolute, OpenGameArt, CC0

music.name: Midnight Tale
music.description: quiet guitar and lute by the tavern fire, no percussion; for winding down after a long day, or a drink and a story
